descriptionFull: The Eurasian eagle-owl ( Bubo bubo ) is a species of eagle-owl that resides in much of Eurasia. It is also called the European eagle-owl and in Europe, where it is the only member of its genus besides the snowy owl ( B. scandiacus ), it is occasionally abbreviated to just eagle-owl .
